summary: A mixed day with significant legal rulings, regulatory developments in market infrastructure, and notable retail sector movements. Key focus on high court decisions, SEBI's new IT resilience framework, and retail expansion plans.

bullets.text: Karnataka HC upholds bail for BJP MLA Byrathi Basavaraj in murder case despite state's plea for cancellation.
SEBI introduces IT Resilience Index for market infrastructure institutions to strengthen cybersecurity and operational continuity.
Starbucks India resumes aggressive expansion after two-year business model recalibration pause.
TCS acquires Porsche IT unit with €1.25 billion five-year services commitment for AI deployment.
Reliance and Rolls-Royce to collaborate on India's AMCA fighter jet engine development project.
